spans.s: Vaṅga^1, a prince. § 170 (Dīrghatamas): I, 104, 4219 (born by Sudeshṇā, the wife of Bali from Dīrghatamas). 4220 (after him the country of the Vaṅgas is named).
Vaṅga^2, a Vaṅga king of the past. § 277 (Jarāsandhavadhap.): II, 21, 804 (Aṅga-Vºādayaḥ…purā). Cf. the prec.

Vaṅga^3, the Vaṅga king at the time of Yudhishṭhira. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 119 (Aṅga-Vºau, waited upon Yudhishṭhira), 120.--§ 287 (Rājasūyikap.): II, 34, 1270 (came to the rājasūya of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 92, 4104 (rājñā).
Vaṅga^4, the country of the Vaṅgas. § 170 (Dīrghatamas): I, 104, 4220 (named after Vaṅga^1).

Vaṅga (mostly Bº in C.), pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 249 (Arjunavanavāsap.): I, 215, 7820 (Aṅga-Vº-Kaliṅgeshu yāni tīrthāṇi).--§ 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 584 (º-Puṇḍra-Kirāteshu rājā…Pauṇḍrako Vāsudevaḥ).-§ 290 (Śiśupālavadhap.): II, 44, 1527 (Vºāṅgavishayādhyakshaṃ…Karṇaṃ).--§ 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1872 (brought tribute to Yudhishṭhira), 1874.--§ 342 (Indralokābhigamanap.): III, 51, 1988 (sa-Vºāṅgān, had been present at the rājasūya).--§ 515 (Karṇadigvijaya): III, 254, 15243 (vanquished by Karṇa on his digvijaya).--§ 561g (Sahadeva): V, 50, 1896 (only C. (Bº), B. has Aṅgān, had been vanquished by Sahadeva).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 353.--§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 91, 4074 (ºānām adhipaḥ); 92, 4102 (do., fought with Ghaṭotkaca), 4107 (ºānām īśvaraḥ, do.).--§ 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 11, 396 (had formerly been vanquished by Kṛshṇa).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 24, 1052 (had sided with Duryodhana).--§ 595 (Shoḍaśarāj. v. Rāma Jāmadagnya): VII, 70, 2436 (Aṅga-Vº-Kaliṅgān, had been slain by Rāma).-§ 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 161, 7206.--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 8, 236 (had been vanquished by Karṇa and caused to pay tribute to Duryodhana).--§ 605 (do.): VIII, 17, †671 (Kaliṅga-Vºāṅgaº); 22, 863.--§ 608 (do.): VIII, 70, †3500 (Kaliṅga-Vºāṅgaº).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 82, 2464 (samudratīreṇa, vanquished by Arjuna when he guarded the sacrificial horse).
Vaṅgādhipa (“the king of the Vaṅgas”). § 233 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 187, †7020 (sought to win Draupadī at her svayaṃvara).
Vaṅgarāja (do.). § 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 30, 1097 (vanquished by Bhīmasena on his digvijaya).

Vaṅkshu, a river, probably the Oxus. § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 51, 1840 (rāsabhān…Vºtīrasamudbhavān), 1846 (rāsabhān…Vºtīranivāsinaḥ [Vaṅkū-º and Vaṅkshu-º], only C.).--§ 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7648 (B. Cakshuḥ).
